name: sales_pitch
hook: I gave this pitch a live hype meter.

questions.label: Concrete metric
questions.instructions: Does this sentence give a concrete, measurable number (users, revenue, speed, price)?

questions.label: Buzzwords
questions.instructions: Is this sentence mostly buzzwords (AI-powered, revolutionary, disruptive, next-gen) with little concrete meaning?

questions.label: Overpromise
questions.instructions: Does this sentence promise results that sound too good to be true or are not backed up?

questions.label: Urgency pressure
questions.instructions: Does this sentence push artificial urgency or scarcity (act now, limited time, only a few left)?

questions.label: Vague benefit
questions.instructions: Does this sentence describe a benefit so vaguely that it cannot be checked?
